name: Souleater

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +3 Enhancement Bonus : +3 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Mortal Strike
effects.tooltip: Mortal Strike : On an attack roll of 20 which is confirmed as a critical hit this weapon triggers the Slay Living spell and attempts to instantly snuff out the life force of the enemy (DC 17).

effects.name: Feeding
effects.tooltip: Feeding 10 : On Vorpal Hit : Your target incurs one Negative Level , and you gain +10 temporary hit points . (These Temporary Hit Points last for one minute, or until used to negate incoming damage.)

effects.name: Vampirism
effects.tooltip: Vampirism 1 : This weapon thirsts for the blood of your enemies, healing you for +1d2 hit points with each hit. Note: internal cooldown of 1 second.

flavor_text: This is the staff used by the sahuagin High Priestess Slikir to commune with and channel a demon. It took on many of the demon's aspects and is now a dangerous and corrupted implement.
tips: Was originally Steel, but someone mentioned it now being Wood (probably to match Epic Souleater ).
